name: opum
description: Opum's public plugin index: federated entries for the lore and quest CLI skills, each cut from the same release tag as the CLI it describes.

plugins.name: opum-lore
plugins.description: Drive the lore CLI: author, retrieve, and maintain OKF documentation bundles, including explicit multi-repository workspaces. Federated: this entry pins the lore-cli release tag, so the skill is cut from the same tag as the CLI it describes and cannot drift from it.

plugins.name: opum-quest
plugins.description: Drive the quest CLI: file, plan, record and complete tracker work in a Quest workspace. Federated: pinned to the quest-cli release tag so the skill cannot drift from the CLI it describes.
